limits: No all-clear from zero alerts. No universal football oracle.
5Hz trajectories cannot certify sub-frame contacts or continuous actual 30fps UI.
Restart information is optional. Without taker metadata readiness is NOT_OBSERVABLE; even with it only taker distance is screened.
Pass/shot intent, exact user choice execution and scene transition semantics need event-linked input.
Ability, offside, legality and outcome quality are not inferred from geometric candidates.
report.inheritedNearLimit: Existing narrow P7 near-goal helper retains top5 witnesses. Its omissions are explicit; new relation candidates and10s cells are not top-N filtered.
